title: Migrate switcherSheetPinGuardRequiredProvider to @riverpod codegen and move it to presentation/providers/
why: This provider was added fresh in commit 2c346a77 ('AN-2 gate escalating actions... wave-B'), not part of the 121-usage legacy backlog the standard exempts — SM-1 explicitly says to count new additions. Every other provider in the same feature already uses @riverpod codegen (profile_providers.dart:129,137,147; active_profile_provider.dart:42). Because it's a manually-declared, non-family FutureProvider it is never autoDispose: once any widget reads it, it and its watch of profileListStreamProvider/activeProfileIdProvider stay alive for the app's remaining lifetime, not just while the switcher sheet is open. The doc comment's stated reason for going manual ('so tests can inject a known result without touching FlutterSecureStorage') doesn't require it — codegen providers are equally overridable in tests, as the neighboring codegen providers demonstrate.
recommendation: Rewrite as an @riverpod FutureProvider<bool> under presentation/providers/, keeping the same override-based test seam.
acceptance_criteria: switcherSheetPinGuardRequiredProvider is annotated @riverpod and lives in lib/features/profiles/presentation/providers/
an2_switcher_pin_guard_test.dart's existing overrides continue to pass unmodified
No manually-declared top-level Provider/FutureProvider remains under presentation/widgets/ in this feature
